mapper.select: SELECT 'COMMUNITY' AS subject_type, c.community_id AS subject_id, c.community_id, c.community_name AS label, c.address_line AS subtitle, c.longitude, c.latitude, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM spatial_boundary sb WHERE sb.subject_type='COMMUNITY' AND sb.subject_id=c.community_id AND sb.status='ACTIVE') AS boundary_ready FROM community c WHERE c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.community_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND c.community_id IN #{id}AND 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT 'BUILDING', b.building_id, b.community_id, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' ', COALESCE(b.building_name, b.building_no)), CONCAT(c.community_name, ' ', b.building_no), b.longitude, b.latitude, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM spatial_boundary sb WHERE sb.subject_type='BUILDING' AND sb.subject_id=b.building_id AND sb.status='ACTIVE') FROM building b JOIN community c ON c.community_id=b.community_id WHERE b.status='ACTIVE' AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND (b.building_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.building_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CONCAT(c.community_name, ' ', b.building_no) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND b.community_id IN #{id}AND 1=0 ORDER BY subject_type, label LIMIT 30

SELECT subject_type, subject_id, CAST(boundary_geojson AS CHAR) AS geo_json, coordinate_system, boundary_source AS source, status, version, verified_at FROM spatial_boundary WHERE subject_type=#{subjectType} AND subject_id=#{subjectId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spatial_boundary(subject_type, subject_id, boundary_geojson, coordinate_system, boundary_source, status, verified_at, created_by_account_id, version) VALUES(#{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, CAST(#{geoJson} AS JSON), 'GCJ02', 'MANUAL', 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), #{accountId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE boundary_geojson=IF(version=#{expectedVersion}, VALUES(boundary_geojson), boundary_geojson), verified_at=IF(version=#{expectedVersion}, VALUES(verified_at), verified_at), created_by_account_id=IF(version=#{expectedVersion}, VALUES(created_by_account_id), created_by_account_id), version=IF(version=#{expectedVersion}, version+1, version)
